scope.publicErpSchemas: 1–4 unchanged; DTO1 is a separate bounded browser protocol
scope.privatePgAppend: Retains the already independently guarded cumulative invoicing TEST operation set; not a payment-only PostgreSQL capability.

invariants.admission: Trusted browser Auth and effective D1 US membership/entitlement pre/post; read-only getZentraUser with no token refresh or offered rights. PG independently locks living role/version/policy and explicitly DB-owner administered opt-in/version inside every wrapper, including exact receipt/replay. This is not distributed transactional D1/Auth/PG authority.
invariants.navigation: Independent installed marker preserves private promotion discovery even when core/ERP/pilot flags close. Promoted denied/closed spaces never choose frozen ERP4. Nonpromoted member/read_only retain legacy access. The installed marker must never be unset after any promotion.
invariants.transport: Head returns only consumer/schema/org/revision without full replay. Bounded lists and invoice detail bind the financial book revision; stale pages conflict and no private book, tax proofs, policy or grant DTO is exposed to the browser.
invariants.accounting: Received, credited and outstanding are separate exact minor-unit values. Actual ledger reports use the unique current book, including credits and purchasing; no second writable ledger or received=total-outstanding inference.
invariants.recovery: Browser request UUID maps to one private payment identity/key. Unknown outcomes retain exact retry; a real lost response after PostgreSQL commit does not duplicate receipt. Background head refresh preserves drafts and requires explicit review of a changed balance.
invariants.trustBoundary: Private service_role retains direct trusted-server access to existing tables/RPCs; the opt-in fences this consumer through its wrapper protocol, not arbitrary service credentials.

limitations: PGlite is serialized; two HTTP clients are not two PostgreSQL connections or two visual browser instances.
Clean NodeFS close/reopen is not crash recovery, load, durability SLA or production scaling proof.
Browser visuals use fictitious memory-kernel data and synthetic authority; PG/socket and visual evidence are separate.
Auth/D1 pre/post checks and PG-local grants/opt-in do not form a distributed transaction.
Private wrappers retain cumulative invoicing TEST actions; payment-only restriction belongs to the public browser handlers.
No hosted migration, production rollout, actual provider calculation/write, native build or accounting/tax certification.

rollback.plan: Close pilot/core flags or revoke and advance private opt-in/grants. Preserve installed marker, immutable history and compatible readers; never delete tail or fall back to frozen ERP4.

remaining: Hosted/staging authority convergence, actual multi-connection race and load/crash validation.
Country/profile changes, unsupported commands and legacy sidecars remain separately gated.
Actual provider sandbox/outbox/transactions/reversals and native/public rollout require later approved phases.
